text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
You first reported it at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in this channel. The post says both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 AM post says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, so the guard was checking trailers in by hand until then.

I posted this reply in #inc-vtg-hartford. It also quotes the SUP-5380 ticket's 08:12 entry ("Rebot failed; drivers queueing"). That entry came from the knowledge brain, not from this channel, and I should have checked before quoting it here. Mateo, Odile, Nadia and Ruth can all read this channel and may not be on team-strategic, which is where the ticket lives. If that entry shouldn't be visible to them, it needs to come down; I can't edit or delete posts with my tools, so someone with access will have to do that.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: Gideon's 11:08 AM post on 3 Aug says the status-page screenshot is attached to ticket INC-4821. I posted that answer in #inc-vtg-hartford. I haven't opened the ticket to confirm the attachment is there.
